name: ecommerces
description: Prabin Store monorepo: storefront, admin dashboard and API.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,store,admin -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend" "npm run dev -w dashboard"
scripts.build: npm run build -w frontend && npm run build -w dashboard
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w frontend && npm run lint -w dashboard
